name: Recursive Infinite-City Ink World
composition: Macro geometry first: vortex, spiral, mandala, labyrinth, sinkhole, terraced funnel, conch, Om, Sri Yantra or multi-vortex; architecture/objects follow flow lines.
prompt_core: Create a monochrome recursive ink-world for [SUBJECT]. Begin with a readable macro geometry before any details: vortex, spiral, mandala, labyrinth, sinkhole or terraced funnel. Build the entire world from repeated forms related to the subject, such as temples, bridges, trees, rivers, shrines, domes, gates, stairs, animals, weapons or symbolic forms. Every large form contains smaller forms, which contain smaller forms again. Use only black technical pen on white paper, engraving-level detail, cross-hatching and line density for depth. The image must feel ancient, obsessive, impossible, archaeological and alive.
negative: no colour, no watercolour, no soft shading, no single cityscape, no modern glass towers, no minimalism, no CGI
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.

consistency: Match the built-in reference images exactly where present (linework, palette, texture, rhythm).
